1) SHOW FULL PROCESSLIST 找当前长时间运行的 SQL，必: 1) Run SHOW FULL PROCESSLIST to find long-running SQL and KILL <id> to stop the bleeding if needed; 2) Use mysqldumpslow -s t -t 10 <slow_log> or pt-query-digest to find the top slow queries; 3) Run EXPLAIN on the queries you found to inspect the plan, then add indexes or rewrite them; 4) If the noise comes from long_query_time being set too low, tune that parameter instead of ignoring the alert.
1) SHOW FULL PROCESSLIST 按来源主机统计连接，找出连接数: 1) Run SHOW FULL PROCESSLIST and group connections by source host to find the application with an abnormal connection count; 2) Tell a traffic spike apart from an application connection pool leak (many long-lived Sleep connections piling up); 3) As an emergency measure raise max_connections, checking free memory at the same time to avoid an OOM; 4) For the root cause, cap the application connection pool and shorten wait_timeout.
1) SHOW FULL PROCESSLIST 看堆积的线程集中在哪条 SQL: 1) Run SHOW FULL PROCESSLIST to see which SQL statement and which table the piled-up threads are concentrated on; 2) Run SHOW ENGINE INNODB STATUS to check for lock waits or deadlocks; 3) KILL the offending SQL to stop the bleeding, then add indexes or apply rate limiting; 4) Check whether an upstream traffic spike or a slow dependency is keeping connections from being released.
1) SHOW SLAVE STATUS\\G 看 Last_SQL_Error: 1) Run SHOW SLAVE STATUS\G on the replica and read Last_SQL_Error to identify the event it is stuck on; 2) If it is a conflict that can be safely skipped (such as a duplicate primary key), verify the data is consistent, then run SET GLOBAL sql_slave_skip_counter=1 followed by START SLAVE SQL_THREAD; 3) If the primary and replica data have already diverged, rebuild the replica from a backup instead of blindly skipping; 4) Take read traffic off this replica before you start.
1) SHOW SLAVE STATUS\\G 看 Seconds_Behind: 1) Run SHOW SLAVE STATUS\G and read Seconds_Behind_Master together with the event the SQL thread is currently applying; 2) On the primary, run SHOW PROCESSLIST to check for a large transaction or a bulk DML loading data; 3) If the replica applies single-threaded, enable parallel replication (slave_parallel_workers / slave_parallel_type=LOGICAL_CLOCK); 4) If the lag keeps growing, move read traffic back to the primary or to another replica.
1) 在从库执行 SHOW SLAVE STATUS\\G 看 Last_IO_: 1) Run SHOW SLAVE STATUS\G on the replica and read Last_IO_Error; 2) The usual causes are the primary being unreachable, an invalid replication account, or the required binlog having been purged — fix the network, reset the account with CHANGE MASTER TO, or rebuild the replica from a backup respectively; 3) Then run START SLAVE IO_THREAD and confirm Slave_IO_Running=Yes; 4) Take read traffic off this replica before you start.
1) 查看 error log（SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'log: 1) Check the error log (the file pointed to by SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'log_error') to tell a crash, an OOM kill and a manual restart apart; 2) If it was an OOM, compare innodb_buffer_pool_size against the machine's physical memory and lower it; 3) If the restart was unplanned, check whether systemd or the container orchestrator is repeatedly restarting it; 4) After the restart, confirm replication resumed automatically and application connection pools reconnected.
1) 用 SHOW GLOBAL STATUS LIKE 'Open_files: 1) Run SHOW GLOBAL STATUS LIKE 'Open_files' and SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'open_files_limit' to confirm the current level; 2) Raise open_files_limit in my.cnf and raise the system ulimit -n and the systemd LimitNOFILE to match; 3) Check whether table_open_cache is set too large and inflating the handle count; 4) Check whether a large number of partitioned or small tables are being accessed at once.
1) 登录主机用 systemctl status mysqld 或 docke: 1) Log in to the host and run systemctl status mysqld or docker ps to confirm the process is alive; 2) If it is alive, connect by hand with mysql -h<host> -P<port> -u<user> -p to tell a hung instance apart from a network or account problem; 3) If it is not running, read the tail of the error log to identify the cause (OOM, full disk, corrupted data files) before starting it — do not blindly restart; 4) If replication is in use, immediately assess whether to fail over, and confirm the application has taken this node out of rotation.
1) 调大 innodb_log_buffer_size（通常从默认 16M 翻: 1) Raise innodb_log_buffer_size (typically doubling the 16M default up to 64M~256M); 2) Check whether innodb_log_file_size is too small and causing frequent checkpoints; 3) Run iostat -x 1 to see whether the disk holding the redo log is already at full utilization; 4) Check for large transactions writing too much data at once and split them into smaller batches.
InnoDB 因 redo log buffer 空间不足而等待刷盘，写入被阻塞: InnoDB is waiting on redo log buffer space before it can flush; writes are blocked and write transaction latency will rise noticeably.
MySQL 仪表盘（使用 address 筛选，用于中心端 Categraf 采: MySQL Dashboard (filtered by address, for a central Categraf scraping multiple remote MySQL instances)
MySQL 仪表盘（使用 instance 筛选，需要采集时自行打上 insta: MySQL Dashboard (filtered by instance, requires attaching an instance label at collection time)
MySQL 仪表盘，适用于 Categraf 采集本机 MySQL 的场景: MySQL Dashboard, for Categraf scraping the local MySQL instance
MySQL 实例在 1 分钟内重启过，重启期间连接全部中断、InnoDB 缓冲池: The MySQL instance restarted within the last minute; all connections dropped and the InnoDB buffer pool started cold, so the workload will be unstable for a while.
从库 IO 线程已停止，不再从主库拉取 binlog，从库数据停止更新，读流量会: The replica IO thread has stopped and no longer pulls binlog from the primary; replica data stops updating and read traffic will see stale data.
从库 SQL 线程已停止，binlog 拉回来了但不再回放，从库数据停止更新且延: The replica SQL thread has stopped: binlog is still being fetched but no longer applied, so replica data stops updating and the lag keeps growing.
从库复制延迟已超过 30 秒，读写分离场景下会读到明显过期的数据。: Replication lag on the replica is over 30 seconds; with read/write splitting, reads will return noticeably stale data.
已建立连接数达到 max_connections 的 80%，再涨新连接会被拒绝: Established connections have reached 80% of max_connections; any further growth means new connections are rejected with Too many connections and the application errors out.
已打开文件句柄数达到 open_files_limit 的 80%，触顶后 My: Open file handles have reached 80% of open_files_limit; once it tops out MySQL cannot open new table files and fails with Too many open files.
最近 5 分钟慢查询累计超过 10 条，超过 long_query_time 的: More than 10 slow queries accumulated in the last 5 minutes; SQL exceeding long_query_time holds connections and IO for a long time and can cascade into taking the instance down under concurrency.
正在执行的线程数已达 max_connections 的 60%，说明 SQL: Running threads have reached 60% of max_connections, which means SQL is piling up without returning; further growth will exhaust connections and new requests will be rejected.
采集端已无法连上 MySQL，实例可能已崩溃或网络不通，依赖该库的业务全部不可用: The collector can no longer reach MySQL; the instance may have crashed or the network may be down, and every workload depending on this database is unavailable.
